name: Kelly Walker
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: Some of the most meaningful moments in therapy don't happen when someone learns a new coping strategy. I have a particular interest in neurodivergent children, adolescents and women, developmental trauma, emotional wellbeing, identity, parent-child relationships and the ways our environments shape our capacity to thrive. I particularly enjoy supporting clinicians working with neurodivergent clients, developmental trauma, parent work, play therapy and private practice.

name: Kirsten .
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: Conversations in Nature is a counselling service based in Melbourne, Australia, founded by Kirsten, an ACA Level 4 Counsellor. Therapeutic counselling services across Australia, specialising in areas such as grief and loss, suicide bereavement, childhood trauma and healing from family violence. My counselling is based on compassionate, person-centred, client led approach to mental health and well-being, integrating nature and somatic practices such as trauma-informed yoga, Psycho-Education.

name: Laura Bartal
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Laura is an ACA accredited counsellor and neurodivergent specialist based on the Mornington Peninsula, offering in-person sessions and Telehealth across Australia. With postgraduate qualifications in counselling, child and adolescent mental health, and a Masters in Autism and Neurodivergence, alongside over two decades of experience in leadership, executive coaching, and organisational consulting, Laura brings both specialist clinical training and real-world depth to her practice. Lumina Therapy specialises in working with neurodivergent individuals, couples, and families.
